title: The Blueberry Picking Map
story: Wild blueberries ripen all over the hills behind Thimble Harbor in late July, just in time for the August festival. Mabel and three neighbors each picked a different patch, one picker a day from Wednesday to Saturday. Now Mabel is drawing a picking map for next year, every label spelled just so, to show which patch ripens when. Who picked which patch, and on which day?

texts: The north field picker picked earlier in the week than the hilltop picker.
Of the hilltop picker and the Wednesday picker, one is Jade and the other is Mabel.
Vito picked on neither Thursday nor Friday.
Mabel picked on neither Wednesday nor Friday.
Ruben worked neither the north field nor the creekside patch.

trace.text: Clue 1 means the north field patch cannot be Saturday and the hilltop patch cannot be Wednesday.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Ruben must go with the stone wall patch: clue 5 rules out the north field patch and the creekside patch; clue 2 rules out the hilltop patch.
Vito must go with Saturday: clue 2 rules out Wednesday; clue 3 rules out Thursday and Friday.
Mabel must go with Thursday: clue 4 rules out Wednesday and Friday; Saturday already goes with Vito.
Ruben must go with Friday: clue 2 rules out Wednesday; the other choices are already taken.
Jade must go with Wednesday: the other choices are already taken.
The stone wall patch goes with Ruben, so the stone wall patch also goes with Friday.
Vito must go with the creekside patch: clue 2 rules out the hilltop patch; the north field patch is already ruled out for Saturday; the stone wall patch already goes with Ruben.
The hilltop patch must go with Thursday: clue 1 rules out Wednesday; Saturday is already ruled out for Vito; Friday already goes with the stone wall patch.
The north field patch must go with Wednesday: clue 1 rules out Saturday; the other choices are already taken.
The creekside patch must go with Saturday: the other choices are already taken.
Mabel must go with the hilltop patch: the north field patch is already ruled out for Thursday; the other choices are already taken.
Jade must go with the north field patch: the other choices are already taken.
